title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE HOW LONG EVERYONE HAS LEFT?

segments.line: A man at the bus stop has twelve seconds left..
Sam grabs his collar and pulls..
A truck runs the red light.. His
timer spins.. Twelve seconds becomes forty-one years..
What if you could see how long everyone has left??
Green means decades.. Orange means years..
Red means hurry.. You can't see your
own.. Not in a mirror.. Then one
morning,, Lily's number drops.. Eighty-one
years,, down to two days..
Saturday,, two forty.. Her birthday.. Forty-eight hours.. So you start
testing everyone.. Your best friend,, Alex.. Orange
hoodie.. You check Alex.. Fifteen thousand,, two hundred and four days..
Mister Ortiz,, the janitor.. Nine thousand,, four hundred and twelve.. He
waters the dead plant every morning..
Maya,, the quiet girl in the library.. Seventeen thousand,, eight hundred and forty-two.. She writes a
novel no one ever reads.. You see the
mother again.. Her number says forty-one..
Yesterday it said forty-two..
The baby still says nineteen thousand,, eight hundred and one.. The numbers are
brightest over the people you already know.. The
strangers are dim.. Like a light turned low.. The people you love
burn bright.. You start doing small
kindnesses.. You carry
boxes and hold doors.. It feels good.. And then
you tell Alex his number.. Fifteen thousand,, two hundred and four days.. Forty-one years..
Use them..
He laughs.. Then he stops.. He stops
applying to college.. Then why
bother,, he says.. You try to take it
back.. The number is in his head now.. You start
sorting people.. You
sit next to the big numbers.. You walk past the small ones.. You catch yourself doing it.. And you feel
sick.. That night,, you look in
the mirror.. Nothing above your head.. You stand on
a chair,, phone up.. Nothing.. You can't see your
own.. Saturday,, two forty..
Counting down.. Fourteen
days.. Use every one..
Part one.. So...... what would yours say??
